model.name: naturalClass.deriveOwnName
model.description: Each natural class computes its own derivedName from its content (Image=capture datetime, Email=subject, Contact=full name, CalendarEntry=title+date, File=clean basename); registered per class (no central switch); derivedName is the fallback when no user displayName (R40.104); originalName preserved never shown.
model.note: class/method=null - architect wires per-class deriveName registration on build-go; extends R40.99; pairs R40.104.
